verse.verse_1: By the (angels) who tear out (the souls of the wicked) with violence;
verse.verse_2: By those who gently draw out (the souls of the blessed);
verse.verse_3: And by those who glide along (on errands of mercy),
verse.verse_4: Then press forward as in a race,
verse.verse_5: Then arrange to do (the Commands of their Lord),
verse.verse_6: One Day everything that can be in commotion will be in violent commotion,
verse.verse_8: Hearts that Day will be in agitation;
verse.verse_9: Cast down will be (their owners') eyes.
verse.verse_10: They say (now): "What! shall we indeed be returned to (our) former state?
verse.verse_11: "What! - when we shall have become rotten bones?"
verse.verse_12: They say: "It would, in that case, be a return with loss!"
verse.verse_13: But verily, it will be but a single (Compelling) Cry,
verse.verse_14: When, behold, they will be in the (full) awakening (to Judgment).
verse.verse_15: Has the story of Moses reached thee?
verse.verse_16: Behold, thy Lord did call to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa:-
verse.verse_17: "Go thou to Pharaoh for he has indeed transgressed all bounds:
verse.verse_18: "And say to him, 'Wouldst thou that thou shouldst be purified (from sin)?-
verse.verse_19: "'And that I guide thee to thy Lord, so thou shouldst fear Him?'"
verse.verse_20: Then did (Moses) show him the Great Sign.
verse.verse_22: Further, he turned his back, striving hard (against Allah).
verse.verse_23: Then he collected (his men) and made a proclamation,
verse.verse_24: Saying, "I am your Lord, Most High".
verse.verse_25: But Allah did punish him, (and made an) example of him, - in the Hereafter, as in this life.
verse.verse_26: Verily in this is an instructive warning for whosoever feareth (Allah).
verse.verse_27: What! Are ye the more difficult to create or the heaven (above)? (Allah) hath constructed it:
verse.verse_28: On high hath He raised its canopy, and He hath given it order and perfection.
verse.verse_29: Its night doth He endow with darkness, and its splendour doth He bring out (with light).
verse.verse_30: And the earth, moreover, hath He extended (to a wide expanse);
verse.verse_31: He draweth out therefrom its moisture and its pasture;
verse.verse_32: And the mountains hath He firmly fixed;-
verse.verse_33: For use and convenience to you and your cattle.
verse.verse_34: Therefore, when there comes the great, overwhelming (Event),-
verse.verse_35: The Day when man shall remember (all) that he strove for,
verse.verse_36: And Hell-Fire shall be placed in full view for (all) to see,-
verse.verse_37: Then, for such as had transgressed all bounds,
verse.verse_38: And had preferred the life of this world,
verse.verse_40: And for such as had entertained the fear of standing before their Lord's (tribunal) and had restrained (their) soul from lower desires,
verse.verse_41: Their abode will be the Garden.
verse.verse_42: They ask thee about the Hour,-'When will be its appointed time?
verse.verse_43: Wherein art thou (concerned) with the declaration thereof?
verse.verse_44: With thy Lord in the Limit fixed therefor.
verse.verse_45: Thou art but a Warner for such as fear it.
verse.verse_46: The Day they see it, (It will be) as if they had tarried but a single evening, or (at most till) the following morn!
